title: International Payment Gateway Suite
summary: Five cross-border payment gateway integrations with split payments, hold-and-capture, refunds and multi-currency returns, built on PCI-DSS aligned tokenisation.
description:
Designed and delivered 5 international payment gateway integrations over REST APIs, following PCI-DSS principles with client-side iframe tokenisation and hosted checkout.

The work covered the complete transaction lifecycle for multi-country storefronts: marketplace split payments between sellers and the platform, hold-and-capture flows for order fulfilment, partial and full refunds, and multi-currency return workflows where the customer pays in one currency and the vendor settles in another.
highlights:
Stripe, Stripe Connect, dLocal Go, CyberSource Secure Acceptance and Mercado Pago integrated over REST APIs.
Client-side iframe tokenisation and hosted checkout to keep card data out of the server trust boundary.
Marketplace split payments with automatic seller payouts, refunds and hold-and-capture settlement.
Multi-currency return handling for cross-border storefronts.
PCI-DSS aligned integration patterns across every gateway.
tech_stack: PHP, Stripe, Stripe Connect, dLocal Go, CyberSource, Mercado Pago, REST API, jQuery

title: Multi-Vendor POS & Retail System
summary: Extended a multi-vendor point-of-sale platform with cashier sessions, drawer checkout, X/Z reports, QR invoicing and a multi-currency RMA flow.
description:
Extended a multi-vendor Point-of-Sale system with outlet and cashier session handling, drawer-based checkout, X/Z reports, QR-scanned invoices, and an RMA flow with multi-currency and multi-language support.

Every store operates as an isolated outlet with its own cash session, so day-end reconciliation (the X and Z reports) reconciles each cashier's drawer against the shift's orders without cross-outlet interference.
highlights:
Outlet and cashier session handling with clean handover between shifts.
Drawer-based checkout with X (shift) and Z (day) end-of-day reports.
QR-scanned invoices so customers pay directly from a printed or digital bill.
RMA (return merchandise authorisation) flow with multi-currency and multi-language support.
Multi-vendor catalog with per-outlet pricing and inventory.
tech_stack: PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap, CS-Cart, Multi-currency, I18n

title: Marketplace: Auctions, Bookings & C2C Selling
summary: Marketplace workflows covering live auctions, multi-day booking and rental inventory, and customer-to-customer selling.
description:
Developed marketplace workflows including auctions, multi-day booking/rental, and customer-to-customer (C2C) selling.

Booking and rental logic handles date-range inventory, per-day pricing and calendar availability, while the auction engine handles bidding windows and winner determination. C2C flows let buyers list, negotiate and settle with other customers inside the same platform.
highlights:
Auction engine with bidding windows, bid validation and winner determination.
Multi-day booking and rental inventory with per-day pricing and availability calendars.
Customer-to-customer (C2C) selling with listing, negotiation and settlement.
Vendor commission and payout logic across the three marketplace models (B2B, B2C, C2C).
tech_stack: PHP, MySQL, CS-Cart, OpenCart, REST API, Webhooks, MySQL Events

title: OMS Integration Connectors
summary: Order management style connectors syncing products, categories, customers and orders — unidirectional (GraphQL, Bagisto) and bidirectional (REST, Unopim).
description:
Designed and developed OMS-style connectors, unidirectional (GraphQL, Bagisto) and bidirectional (REST, Unopim), syncing products, categories, customers, and orders across e-commerce platforms.

The connectors normalise each platform's schema into a canonical product and order model, so a single catalogue change propagates to every connected store with conflict handling for bidirectional flows.
highlights:
Unidirectional connectors over GraphQL (Bagisto) for catalogue and order export.
Bidirectional connectors over REST (Unopim PIM) with two-way product, category, customer and order sync.
Conflict resolution for concurrent edits across platforms.
Idempotent imports with checkpointing so a failed sync resumes instead of duplicating.
tech_stack: PHP, GraphQL, REST API, Unopim (PIM), Bagisto, WooCommerce, Shopify, Webhooks

title: Shipping, OTP & Location Integrations
summary: Third-party APIs for live shipping rates, label generation, pickup scheduling, OTP delivery and geo-addressing.
description:
Integrated third-party APIs for shipping (real-time rates, label generation, pickup scheduling), OTP authentication (Twilio/WhatsApp), and location services (Google address autocomplete, DigiPIN geo-addressing).

Shipping carrier responses are normalised into a single rate structure so checkout can compare couriers regardless of carrier, and OTP delivery is abstracted behind one provider interface with WhatsApp as an alternative channel.
highlights:
Real-time shipping rate comparison across multiple carriers, normalised into one rate model.
Label generation and pickup scheduling flows.
OTP authentication over Twilio and WhatsApp with a single provider interface.
Google address autocomplete and India Post's React-based DigiPIN geo-addressing implemented inside PHP-based platforms.
tech_stack: PHP, Twilio, WhatsApp API, Google Maps SDK, DigiPIN, Shipping Carrier APIs, REST

title: AI/ML Feature Integrations
summary: Production AI/ML API integrations for semantic search, automated image background removal and product category prediction.
description:
Integrated and maintained AI/ML APIs for semantic search, automated image background removal, and product category prediction.

Semantic search lets shoppers query by intent rather than keywords, background removal cleans up marketplace product photography in bulk, and category prediction auto-tags new listings so vendors do not have to pick the taxonomy themselves.
highlights:
Semantic search over the product catalogue with graceful fallback to keyword search.
Automated product image background removal for marketplace listings.
Product category prediction to pre-fill taxonomy on new products.
Tesseract OCR pipelines converting image-based content into structured data.
tech_stack: PHP, Python, AI/ML APIs, Semantic Search, OCR (Tesseract), Playwright

title: Performance, PWA & Delivery
summary: Service workers, caching, prefetching, AMP/PWA techniques, S3 media storage and GTM behaviour tracking.
description:
Improved performance and delivery through service workers, caching, prefetching, AMP/PWA techniques, Amazon S3 media storage, and Google Tag Manager behaviour tracking.

Media was moved to S3 with a CDN in front of it and aggressive cache headers, while service workers and prefetching cut repeat-view latency on catalogue and checkout pages.
highlights:
Service worker caching strategy for catalogue, product and checkout routes.
Link prefetching for high-intent navigation paths.
AMP and PWA techniques for fast first paint on mobile.
Amazon S3 media storage with cache-friendly delivery.
Google Tag Manager behaviour tracking for funnel analysis.
tech_stack: Service Workers, PWA, AMP, Amazon S3, Google Tag Manager, Caching, Sitemaps

title: Legacy PHP Modernization & Code Health
summary: Refactoring, framework version migrations, deprecation handling and theme/plugin compatibility on ageing PHP e-commerce codebases.
description:
Refactored and upgraded PHP e-commerce codebases, framework version migrations, deprecation handling, and custom theme/plugin compatibility, validating changes on staging with QA and deploying to production.

Migrations were run against staging with QA validation before production release, and custom themes and plugins were kept compatible across framework upgrades so client customisations did not silently break.
highlights:
Framework version migrations with zero-downtime release windows.
Deprecation handling and code refactoring to modern PHP patterns.
Custom theme and plugin compatibility maintained across upgrades.
Staging validation with QA and DevOps coordination before production deploys.
Mentored 4 junior developers on company workflows in Linux environments.
tech_stack: PHP, Symfony, CS-Cart, Composer, Git, Linux, PHPUnit
